      let activeView = 'sem3';

      /* --- INITIALIZATION & AUTH SYSTEM --- */
      function checkAuth() {
          const storedRole = localStorage.getItem('simkas_role');
          if (storedRole) {
              userRole = storedRole;
              document.getElementById('loginPage').style.display = 'none';
              document.getElementById('appDashboard').style.display = 'block';

              const b = document.getElementById('userBadge');
              b.innerText = userRole;
              b.className = 'role-badge ' + (userRole === 'admin' ? 'badge-admin' : 'badge-tamu');

              document.getElementById('btnSaveData').style.display = userRole === 'admin' ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
              document.getElementById('btnAddExp').style.display = userRole === 'admin' ? 'inline-block' : 'none';

              switchView('sem3');
              typeTerminal();
          } else {
              document.getElementById('loginPage').style.display = 'flex';
              document.getElementById('appDashboard').style.display = 'none';
              resetRoleSelection();
          }
      }

      function selectRole(role) {
          if (role === 'tamu') {
              localStorage.setItem('simkas_role', 'tamu');
              dismissLoadingScreen();
              checkAuth();
          } else if (role === 'admin') {
              document.getElementById('roleSelector').style.display = 'none';
              document.getElementById('adminForm').style.display = 'block';
              document.getElementById('password').focus();
          }
      }

      function resetRoleSelection() {
          document.getElementById('roleSelector').style.display = 'flex';
          document.getElementById('adminForm').style.display = 'none';
          document.getElementById('password').value = '';
      }

      function handleAdminLogin(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          const p = document.getElementById('password').value;

          if (p === 'calon ahli surga') {
              localStorage.setItem('simkas_role', 'admin');
              checkAuth();
          } else {
              alert('Kata sandi salah! Akses Admin ditolak.');
          }
      }

      function handleLogout() {
          if (confirm("Apakah Anda ingin keluar dari halaman?")) {
              localStorage.removeItem('simkas_role');
              checkAuth();
          }
      }

      /* --- TERMINAL & CLOCK --- */
      function typeTerminal() {
          const currentMsg = logMessages[msgIdx];
          const typingEl = document.getElementById('typingLine');
          if (!typingEl) return;
          if (charIdx < currentMsg.length) {
              typingEl.innerText += currentMsg.charAt(charIdx);
              charIdx++;
              setTimeout(typeTerminal, 40);
          } else {
              setTimeout(() => {
                  const contentEl = document.getElementById('terminalContent');
                  const p = document.createElement('div');
                  p.className = 'terminal-line';
                  p.innerText = "> " + currentMsg;
                  contentEl.appendChild(p);
                  if (contentEl.children.length > 4) contentEl.removeChild(contentEl.firstChild);
                  typingEl.innerText = "";
                  charIdx = 0;
                  msgIdx = (msgIdx + 1) % logMessages.length;
                  setTimeout(typeTerminal, 800);
              }, 1200);
          }
      }

      function initClock() {
          setInterval(() => {
              const now = new Date();
              const liveClock = document.getElementById('liveClock');
              const liveDate = document.getElementById('liveDate');
              if(liveClock) liveClock.innerText = now.toLocaleTimeString('id-ID');
              if(liveDate) liveDate.innerText = now.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
          }, 1000);
      }

      /* --- DASHBOARD VIEW & TABLES --- */
      function switchView(view) {
          activeView = view;
          document.getElementById('btnSem3').classList.toggle('active', view === 'sem3');
          document.getElementById('btnSem4').classList.toggle('active', view === 'sem4');
          document.getElementById('btnKpi').classList.toggle('active', view === 'kpi');

          if (view === 'sem3') {
              document.getElementById('lblRate').innerText = "IURAN / MINGGU";
              document.getElementById('valRate').innerText = "Rp 2.000";
              document.getElementById('valTarget').innerText = "Rp 30.000";
              document.getElementById('lblIn').innerText = "PEMASUKAN (SEM 3)";
              document.getElementById('lblOut').innerText = "PENGELUARAN (SEM 3)";
              document.getElementById('lblSaldo').innerText = "SALDO BERSIH (SEM 3)";
              document.getElementById('lblTunggakan').innerText = "TUNGGAKAN (SEM 3)";
          } else if (view === 'sem4') {
              document.getElementById('lblRate').innerText = "IURAN / BULAN";
              document.getElementById('valRate').innerText = "Rp 4.000";
              document.getElementById('valTarget').innerText = "Rp 12.000";
              document.getElementById('lblIn').innerText = "PEMASUKAN (SEM 4)";
              document.getElementById('lblOut').innerText = "PENGELUARAN (SEM 4)";
              document.getElementById('lblSaldo').innerText = "SALDO BERSIH (SEM 4)";
              document.getElementById('lblTunggakan').innerText = "TUNGGAKAN (SEM 4)";
          }

          if (view === 'kpi') {
              document.getElementById('viewSemester').style.display = 'none';
              document.getElementById('viewKpi').style.display = 'block';
              document.getElementById('lblIn').innerText = "TOTAL PEMASUKAN GLOBAL";
              document.getElementById('lblOut').innerText = "TOTAL PENGELUARAN GLOBAL";

              renderKpiPage();
          } else {
              document.getElementById('viewSemester').style.display = 'grid';
              document.getElementById('viewKpi').style.display = 'none';
              buildKasTable();
              buildExpTable();
              calc();

      function buildKasTable() {
          const head = document.getElementById('mggHead');
          const body = document.getElementById('mhsBody');
          head.innerHTML = '';
          body.innerHTML = '';

          const savedKas = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('simkas_mhs_data_' + activeView));
          const isDisabled = userRole === 'tamu' ? 'disabled' : '';

          if (activeView === 'sem3') {
              document.getElementById('kasTitle').innerText = "📊 Log Kontribusi Kas Semester 3 (15 Minggu)";
              let h = `<th style="width:25px">No</th><th class="nama-mhs">Nama Mahasiswa</th>`;
              for (let i = 1; i <= 15; i++) h += `<th>${i}</th>`;
              h += `<th style="width:65px">Total</th><th style="width:70px">Status</th>`;
              head.innerHTML = h;

              mhsList.forEach((n, i) => {
                  let tr = `<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td class="nama-mhs">${n}</td>`;
                  for (let m = 1; m <= 15; m++) {
                      let isChecked = savedKas && savedKas[n] ? savedKas[n][m-1] : true;
                      tr += `<td><input type="checkbox" class="cb" ${isChecked ? 'checked' : ''} ${isDisabled} onchange="calc()"></td>`;
                  }
                  tr += `<td class="t-val" style="font-weight:700;">0</td><td><span class="st-bad">PROSES</span></td></tr>`;
                  body.innerHTML += tr;
              });
          } else {
              document.getElementById('kasTitle').innerText = "📊 Log Kontribusi Kas Semester 4 (Bulanan)";
              let h = `<th style="width:25px">No</th><th class="nama-mhs">Nama Mahasiswa</th><th>April</th><th>Mei</th><th>Juni</th><th style="width:65px">Total</th><th style="width:70px">Status</th>`;
              head.innerHTML = h;

              mhsList.forEach((n, i) => {
                  let tr = `<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td class="nama-mhs">${n}</td>`;
                  let checks = savedKas && savedKas[n] ? savedKas[n] : (defaultSem4Kas[n] || [true, true, true]);
                  checks.forEach(c => tr += `<td><input type="checkbox" class="cb" ${c ? 'checked' : ''} ${isDisabled} onchange="calc()"></td>`);
                  tr += `<td class="t-val" style="font-weight:700;">0</td><td><span class="st-bad">PROSES</span></td></tr>`;
                  body.innerHTML += tr;
              });
          }
      }

      function buildExpTable() {
          const b = document.getElementById('outBody');
          b.innerHTML = '';

          document.querySelectorAll('.action-col').forEach(el => el.style.display = userRole === 'admin' ? 'table-cell' : 'none');

          const savedExp = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('simkas_exp_data_' + activeView));
          const list = savedExp || (activeView === 'sem3' ? defaultExpSem3 : defaultExpSem4);
          list.forEach(item => addExpRow(item.u, item.t, item.p, item.q));
      }

      function addExpRow(u="", t="", p=0, q=1) {
          const b = document.getElementById('outBody');
          const r = document.createElement('tr');
          const isDisabled = userRole === 'tamu' ? 'disabled' : '';
          const actionTd = userRole === 'admin' ? `
              <td>
                  <button class="btn-tb-edit" onclick="editRow(this)">✏️</button>
                  <button class="btn-tb-del" onclick="deleteRow(this)">🗑️</button>
              </td>` : ``;

          r.innerHTML = `<td><input type="text" class="exp-input exp-u" value="${u}" ${isDisabled}></td>
                         <td><input type="date" class="exp-input exp-t" value="${t}" ${isDisabled}></td>
                         <td><input type="number" class="exp-input p-in" value="${p}" ${isDisabled} oninput="calc()"></td>
                         <td><input type="number" class="exp-input q-in" value="${q}" ${isDisabled} oninput="calc()"></td>
                         <td class="row-tot" style="font-weight:700">0</td>
                         ${actionTd}`;
          b.appendChild(r);
          calc();
      }

      function editRow(btn) {
          if (userRole !== 'admin') return;
          const tr = btn.closest('tr');
          const u = tr.querySelector('.exp-u');
          u.focus();
          u.style.borderColor = 'var(--accent-gold)';
          setTimeout(() => u.style.borderColor = 'transparent', 1500);
      }

      function deleteRow(btn) {
          if (userRole !== 'admin') return;
          if (confirm("Apakah Anda yakin ingin menghapus baris pengeluaran ini?")) {
              const tr = btn.closest('tr');
              tr.remove();
              calc();
          }
      }

      /* --- DATA STORAGE LOGIC --- */
      function saveData(showAlert = false) {
          if (userRole !== 'admin' || activeView === 'kpi') return;

          let mhsData = {};
          document.querySelectorAll('#mhsBody tr').forEach(r => {
              let nama = r.querySelector('.nama-mhs').innerText;
              let cbs = Array.from(r.querySelectorAll('.cb')).map(c => c.checked);
              mhsData[nama] = cbs;
          });
          localStorage.setItem('simkas_mhs_data_' + activeView, JSON.stringify(mhsData));

          let expData = [];
          document.querySelectorAll('#outBody tr').forEach(r => {
              let u = r.querySelector('.exp-u').value;
              let t = r.querySelector('.exp-t').value;
              let p = parseFloat(r.querySelector('.p-in').value) || 0;
              let q = parseFloat(r.querySelector('.q-in').value) || 0;
              expData.push({ u, t, p, q });
          });
          localStorage.setItem('simkas_exp_data_' + activeView, JSON.stringify(expData));

          if (showAlert) alert('Data ' + activeView.toUpperCase() + ' berhasil disimpan!');
      }

      function calc() {
          let currentIn = 0, currentOut = 0, totalTunggakan = 0;
          const rate = activeView === 'sem3' ? 2000 : 4000;
          const targetPerMhs = activeView === 'sem3' ? (15 * 2000) : (3 * 4000);
          let uncompletedList = [];

          document.querySelectorAll('#mhsBody tr').forEach(r => {
              let checkedCount = r.querySelectorAll('.cb:checked').length;
              let p = checkedCount * rate;
              currentIn += p;

              let diff = targetPerMhs - p;
              let nama = r.querySelector('.nama-mhs').innerText;

              if (diff > 0) {
                  totalTunggakan += diff;
                  let cbs = r.querySelectorAll('.cb');
                  if (activeView === 'sem4') {
                      uncompletedList.push({
                          nama: nama,
                          apr: cbs[0].checked ? "Lunas" : "Rp4.000",
                          mei: cbs[1].checked ? "Lunas" : "Rp4.000",
                          jun: cbs[2].checked ? "Lunas" : "Rp4.000",
                          sisa: diff
                      });
                  } else {
                      uncompletedList.push({ nama: nama, sisa: diff });
                  }
              }

              r.querySelector('.t-val').innerText = "Rp " + p.toLocaleString('id-ID');
              let st = r.querySelector('.st-bad');
              if (p >= targetPerMhs) {
                  st.innerText = "LUNAS";
                  st.style.color = "var(--accent-green)";
              } else {
                  st.innerText = "TUNGGAKAN";
                  st.style.color = "var(--accent-red)";
              }
          });

          document.querySelectorAll('#outBody tr').forEach(r => {
              let price = parseFloat(r.querySelector('.p-in').value) || 0;
              let qty = parseFloat(r.querySelector('.q-in').value) || 0;
              let subtotal = price * qty;
              r.querySelector('.row-tot').innerText = "Rp " + subtotal.toLocaleString('id-ID');
              currentOut += subtotal;
          });

          const currentSaldo = currentIn - currentOut;

          document.getElementById('resIn').innerText = "Rp " + currentIn.toLocaleString('id-ID');
          document.getElementById('resOut').innerText = "Rp " + currentOut.toLocaleString('id-ID');
          document.getElementById('resSaldo').innerText = "Rp " + currentSaldo.toLocaleString('id-ID');
          document.getElementById('resTunggakan').innerText = "Rp " + totalTunggakan.toLocaleString('id-ID');

          document.getElementById('fiscAvg').innerText = activeView === 'sem3' ? "Rp 30.000" : "Rp 9.548";
          document.getElementById('fiscStatus').innerText = totalTunggakan === 0 ? "OPTIMAL" : "ATTENTION";
          document.getElementById('fiscStatus').style.color = totalTunggakan === 0 ? "var(--accent-green)" : "var(--accent-red)";

          renderStatusLahanKosong(uncompletedList);
          renderSemesterSpecificChart(currentIn, currentOut);
      }

      function renderStatusLahanKosong(uncompletedList) {
          const head = document.getElementById('statusHead');
          const body = document.getElementById('statusBody');
          head.innerHTML = '';
          body.innerHTML = '';

          if (activeView === 'sem3') {
              document.getElementById('statusPanelTitle').innerText = "🎉 Status Tunggakan Semester 3";
              head.innerHTML = `<tr><th style="text-align:left; padding-left:10px;">Indikator Status</th><th style="text-align:right; padding-right:10px;">Keterangan</th></tr>`;
              body.innerHTML = `
                  <tr><td style="text-align:left; padding-left:10px; font-weight:700;">Mahasiswa Lunas</td><td style="text-align:right; padding-right:10px;"><span class="badge-success">31 / 31 (100%)</span></td></tr>
                  <tr><td style="text-align:left; padding-left:10px; font-weight:700;">Status Kas Kelas</td><td style="text-align:right; padding-right:10px;"><span class="badge-success">Bebas Tunggakan</span></td></tr>
                  <tr><td style="text-align:left; padding-left:10px; font-weight:700;">Tunggakan Kas Aktif</td><td style="text-align:right; padding-right:10px;"><span class="badge-success">Rp 0 (Clear)</span></td></tr>
              `;
          } else {
              document.getElementById('statusPanelTitle').innerText = "⚠️ Rincian " + uncompletedList.length + " Mahasiswa Belum Melunasi (Semester 4)";
              head.innerHTML = `<tr><th style="text-align:left; padding-left:6px;">Nama</th><th>Apr</th><th>Mei</th><th>Jun</th><th>Sisa</th></tr>`;

              uncompletedList.forEach(item => {
                  body.innerHTML += `
                      <tr>
                          <td style="text-align:left; padding-left:6px; font-weight:700; font-size:10px;">${item.nama}</td>
                          <td>${item.apr === 'Lunas' ? '<span class="badge-success">Lunas</span>' : '<span class="badge-danger">'+item.apr+'</span>'}</td>
                          <td>${item.mei === 'Lunas' ? '<span class="badge-success">Lunas</span>' : '<span class="badge-danger">'+item.mei+'</span>'}</td>
                          <td>${item.jun === 'Lunas' ? '<span class="badge-success">Lunas</span>' : '<span class="badge-danger">'+item.jun+'</span>'}</td>
                          <td style="font-weight:800; color:var(--accent-red); font-size:10px;">Rp ${item.sisa.toLocaleString('id-ID')}</td>
                      </tr>
                  `;
              });
          }
      }

      function renderKpiPage() {

      /* --- LOADING SCREEN NAVY & GOLD --- */
      function startFinalLoading() {
          const overlay = document.getElementById('loadingOverlay');
          const status = document.getElementById('loaderStatus');
          if (!overlay || !status) return;
          const messages = [
              'Proses inisialisasi sistem...',
              'Memuat data kas...',
              'Menyiapkan dashboard...',
              'Memeriksa kesiapan sistem...'
          ];
          let index = 0;
          status.textContent = messages[0];
          const interval = setInterval(() => {
              index += 1;
              if (index < messages.length) {
                  status.textContent = messages[index];
              } else {
                  clearInterval(interval);
                  status.textContent = 'Selamat datang.';
                  setTimeout(dismissLoadingScreen, 550);
              }
          }, 700);
      }

      function filterMhs() {
    const input = document.getElementById('searchMhs');
    const filter = input.value.toLowerCase();
    const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#mhsBody tr');

    rows.forEach(row => {
        const namaEl = row.querySelector('.nama-mhs');
        if (namaEl) {
            const namaText = namaEl.textContent || namaEl.innerText;
            row.style.display = namaText.toLowerCase().includes(filter) ? '' : 'none';
        }
    });
}
      function dismissLoadingScreen() {
          const overlay = document.getElementById('loadingOverlay');
          if (!overlay || overlay.classList.contains('loader-hidden')) return;
          overlay.classList.add('loader-hidden');
          setTimeout(() => { overlay.style.display = 'none'; }, 600);
      }

      function printReport() {
          if (userRole !== 'admin') {
              alert('Fitur cetak laporan hanya tersedia untuk Admin.');
              return;
          }
          const oldTitle = document.title;
          document.title = 'Laporan SIM KAS ' + (activeView === 'sem4' ? 'Semester 4' : activeView === 'kpi' ? 'Executive Summary' : 'Semester 3');
          setTimeout(() => {
              window.print();
              document.title = oldTitle;
          }, 100);
      }

      
/* --- DOM INIT --- */
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    localStorage.removeItem('simkas_role');

    initClock();
    checkAuth();
    startFinalLoading();
});
